drafts-xh-01-001.text: Isibhakabhaka sithe cwaka, nomgca uthe cwaka. UMvulo akakayifumani ivolyum.
drafts-xh-01-001.en: The sky's on mute and so is the queue. Monday hasn't found the volume.

drafts-xh-01-002.text: Isibhakabhaka nolwandle bavumelene ngombala ngale ntsasa. Asingombala onomdla.
drafts-xh-01-002.en: Sky and sea agreed on a colour this morning. Not an exciting one.

drafts-xh-01-003.text: Nditsho ne-hadeda ithe cwaka. Isibhakabhaka simisele umzekelo.
drafts-xh-01-003.en: Even the hadeda is keeping it down. The sky set the tone.

drafts-xh-01-004.text: Akukho zithunzi, akukho kukhazimla, akukho zizathu. UMvulo uphantsi kwesiciko seTupperware.
drafts-xh-01-004.en: No shadows, no glare, no excuses. Monday under a Tupperware lid.

drafts-xh-01-005.text: Ilanga alizukuza kujonga ukukhazimla namhlanje. Imoto ayinangxaki ngaloo nto.
drafts-xh-01-005.en: The sun won't be inspecting the shine today. The car is fine with that.

drafts-xh-01-006.text: Akukho sithunzi nesinye ebaleni imini yonke. Usompempe akazange azimeze amehlo.
drafts-xh-01-006.en: Not one shadow on the field all day. The umpire never had to squint.

drafts-xh-01-007.text: Isibhakabhaka singwevu, iijezi zinxitywe, isikolo siphumile. Impelaveki ayidingi mvume yelanga.
drafts-xh-01-007.en: Grey sky, jerseys on, school's out. The weekend doesn't need the sun's permission.

drafts-xh-01-008.text: Ithafa lonke ngathi umbala uthotyiwe. Iigusha zibalwa ngendlela efanayo noko.
drafts-xh-01-008.en: The whole veld with the colour turned down. The sheep count the same either way.

drafts-xh-01-009.text: Isibane seshedi kukutshona kwelanga ngokuhlwanje. Iinkomo zamkela oko.
drafts-xh-01-009.en: The shed bulb is tonight's sunset. The cattle accept the downgrade.

drafts-xh-01-010.text: Isibhakabhaka sisuke kungwevu olukhanyayo saya kungwevu olumnyama. Yayiyiyo yonke imiboniso leyo.
drafts-xh-01-010.en: The sky went from light grey to dark grey. That was the whole show.

drafts-xh-01-011.text: Isibane sokhuseleko sikhanyise kwangethuba. Ilanga alizange liqale umsebenzi kakuhle.
drafts-xh-01-011.en: The security light came on early. The sun never properly clocked in.

drafts-xh-01-012.text: Ulwandle nesibhakabhaka bangwevu ngokufanayo. Zizibane zebhulorho kuphela ezizamileyo.
drafts-xh-01-012.en: Sea and sky in matching grey. Only the pier lights made an effort.

drafts-xh-01-013.text: Iflegi ixela imozulu phambi kwabadlali bamaza. Ithi: hambani.
drafts-xh-01-013.en: The flag's giving the forecast before the surfers do. It says: go.

drafts-xh-01-014.text: Amagqabi eentyatyambo ze-jacaranda nawo akhwele ibhasi. Umoya omncinci uwathengele amatikiti.
drafts-xh-01-014.en: The jacaranda petals are taking the bus too. The breeze bought their tickets.

drafts-xh-01-015.text: Umpompo womoya wenza umsebenzi wakusasa. Ingca iyawuphungela nje isandla.
drafts-xh-01-015.en: The windpump is doing the morning's work. The grass is just waving it on.

drafts-xh-01-016.text: Isandla ekepusini, inyathelo ngenyathelo. Umoya omncinci uhamba naye.
drafts-xh-01-016.en: Hand on the cap, one stride at a time. The breeze is pacing her.

drafts-xh-01-017.text: Impahla iza komelela phambi kwekhefu lokuqala. Umoya omncinci uqale umsebenzi kwangethuba.
drafts-xh-01-017.en: The washing will be dry before first break. The breeze took the early shift.

drafts-xh-01-018.text: Isaqhwithi esincinci sothuli sihamba phambi kwakhe. Asiyityhali nokuyityhala ibhayisekile.
drafts-xh-01-018.en: A little dust devil is riding ahead of him. It isn't even pedalling.

drafts-xh-01-019.text: Iinwele zakhe zifike kuqala evenkileni yesonka. Umoya omncinci uneecebo zawo zangeCawa.
drafts-xh-01-019.en: Her hair got to the bakery first. The breeze has its own Sunday plans.

drafts-xh-01-020.text: Lixesha lekhefu, kwaye umoya omncinci ulungisa iinwele zabo bonke. Nootitshala.
drafts-xh-01-020.en: Break time, and the breeze is doing everyone's hair. Teachers included.

drafts-xh-01-021.text: Umoya omncinci usebenza kwindawo yeziqhamo namhlanje. Ipholisa simahla, akukho mali yongezelelweyo.
drafts-xh-01-021.en: The breeze is working the fruit stall today. Air-con included, no extra charge.

drafts-xh-01-022.text: Umoya omncinci wenza wonke umsebenzi. Ikhayithi ifumana lonke udumo.
drafts-xh-01-022.en: The breeze does all the work. The kite takes all the credit.

drafts-xh-01-023.text: Iflegi yekona ibonisa kanye apho ibhola iza kutyekela khona.
drafts-xh-01-023.en: The corner flag is pointing out exactly where the conversions will drift.

drafts-xh-01-024.text: Amashiti sele omile. Ngoku umoya omncinci uzibonakalisa nje kumntwana.
drafts-xh-01-024.en: The sheets are dry already. Now the breeze is just showing off for the kid.

drafts-xh-01-025.text: Umsi ufike eyadini yabamelwane. Ibraai yangoMgqibelo ngoku yeyoluntu lonke.
drafts-xh-01-025.en: The smoke has found the neighbours' yard. Saturday's braai is officially a community event.

drafts-xh-01-026.text: Izihlangu kwiikona zengubo. Umoya omncinci wamkelekile, isanti ayamkelekanga.
drafts-xh-01-026.en: Shoes on the blanket corners. The breeze is welcome, the sand isn't.

drafts-xh-01-027.text: Iiflegi zolulekile, iwayini ibanjwe ngokuqinileyo. Yile ndlela uMvulo ozolileyo ukhangeleka ngayo apha.
drafts-xh-01-027.en: Flags out straight, wine held tight. The deck's version of a calm Monday.

drafts-xh-01-028.text: Uthuli lukhazimla ngathi yigolide ekukhanyeni kokutshona kwelanga. Umdlalo uyaqhubeka.
drafts-xh-01-028.en: The dust is going for gold in the low light. The match plays on through it.

drafts-xh-01-029.text: Induli ishukuma ngathi ngamaza. Iinkomo zigqibe ekubeni zingaboni nto.
drafts-xh-01-029.en: The hill is moving in waves. The cattle have decided not to notice.

drafts-xh-01-030.text: Umoya omncinci uthutha i-jacaranda iye kwesinye isitrato, intyatyambo ngentyatyambo. Istoep siyavuma.
drafts-xh-01-030.en: The breeze is moving the jacaranda one street over, petal by petal. The stoep approves.

drafts-xh-01-031.text: Impahla bekufanele ingene kwiiyure ezidlulileyo. Umoya omncinci uvote ukuba ihlale.
drafts-xh-01-031.en: The washing should have come in hours ago. The breeze voted to leave it.

drafts-xh-01-032.en: The flags are still chatting. The boats have called it a week.

drafts-xh-01-033.text: Amagqabi asoloko ekhanyisa isibane sokhuseleko. Inja ayisaphakami ngenxa yawo.
drafts-xh-01-033.en: The leaves keep setting off the security light. The dog's stopped getting up for them.

drafts-xh-01-034.text: Umntu uyilibele impahla. Umoya omncinci awuyilibalanga, kwaye wenza umsebenzi omhle.
drafts-xh-01-034.en: Somebody forgot the washing. The breeze didn't, and it's doing a lovely job.

drafts-xh-01-035.text: Umoya omncinci usashushu ngeli xesha. Ulwandle lushiya isifudumezi sivuliwe ubusuku bonke.
drafts-xh-01-035.en: The breeze is still warm at this hour. The sea leaves the heating on all night.

drafts-xh-01-036.text: Umpompo womoya awukholelwa kwixesha lokuphuma emsebenzini. Nenja ayikholelwa.
drafts-xh-01-036.en: The windpump doesn't believe in knock-off time. Neither does the dog.

drafts-xh-01-037.text: Umoya omncinci uthwala umsi usiwa ezantsi kwesitrato. Isitrato sonke siyazi ukuba kutyiwa ntoni ngokuhlwa.
drafts-xh-01-037.en: The breeze is taking the smoke down the block. The whole street knows what's for supper.

drafts-xh-01-038.text: Zonke izibane ezisentanjeni ziyajiwuzela. UMgqibelo ebusuku unesingqi, kancinci nje.
drafts-xh-01-038.en: Every light on the string is swaying. Saturday night has rhythm, barely.

drafts-xh-01-039.text: Isanti iwela indlela ingqanga ngengqanga. Akukho mntu ungxamileyo apha.
drafts-xh-01-039.en: The sand is crossing the road a grain at a time. Nobody here is in a hurry.

drafts-xh-01-040.text: Intaba izigqume intloko ngengubo. Kulungile, nguLwesihlanu.
drafts-xh-01-040.en: The mountain pulled the duvet over its head. Fair enough, it's Friday.

drafts-xh-01-041.text: Ilanga liyangena, liyaphuma. UMvulo uqala kancinci.
drafts-xh-01-041.en: Sun's in, sun's out. Monday's doing a soft launch.

drafts-xh-01-042.text: Amafu alinike ilanga ikhefu ngoLwesibini. Akukho mntu uxelele ubumanzi bomoya.
drafts-xh-01-042.en: The clouds gave the sun Tuesday off. Nobody told the humidity.

drafts-xh-01-043.text: Loo mafu adlula nje. Nditsho nombona uyazi ukuba akufuneki uvuye.
drafts-xh-01-043.en: Those clouds are only passing through. Even the mealies know not to get excited.

drafts-xh-01-044.en: The shade is working down the rows one at a time. It's inspecting.

drafts-xh-01-045.text: Mfusa emhlabeni, mhlophe esibhakabhakeni. Imibala kaLwesihlanu yamkelwe.
drafts-xh-01-045.en: Purple on the ground, white in the sky. Friday's colour scheme is approved.

drafts-xh-01-046.text: Amafu ambalwa eze kubukela. Nawo akabaleki.
drafts-xh-01-046.en: A few clouds came along to watch. Also not running.

drafts-xh-01-047.en: The clouds are drifting through slowly. It's Sunday; they're allowed.

drafts-xh-01-048.text: Ilaphu letafile lentaba lingaphezulu ngesiqingatha kuphela. NguMvulo, akukho mntu unxibe ngokupheleleyo.
drafts-xh-01-048.en: The mountain's tablecloth is only half on. It's Monday, nobody's fully dressed.

drafts-xh-01-049.text: Izithunzi zamafu ziwela ibala zihamba kancinci. Akukho mntu ukhalazayo.
drafts-xh-01-049.en: Cloud shadows crossing the outfield at a steady walk. Nobody's appealing.

drafts-xh-01-050.text: Ilanga, emva koko ilifu, emva koko ilanga. Nditsho neenkawu azikwazi ukwenza icebo.
drafts-xh-01-050.en: Sun, then cloud, then sun. Even the monkeys can't plan around that.

drafts-xh-01-051.text: Inja iwufumene kanye umda phakathi kwelanga nesithunzi. Ihlala khona.
drafts-xh-01-051.en: The dog found the exact line between sun and shade. He's staying put.

drafts-xh-01-052.text: Iiglasi zelanga ziyanxitywa, ziyakhululwa, ziyanxitywa. Emva kwemini ngoLwesihlanu kukuzilolonga.
drafts-xh-01-052.en: Sunglasses on, sunglasses off, sunglasses on. Friday afternoon is interval training.

drafts-xh-01-053.text: Ilifu elinye phezu kwentaba asiyiyo imozulu. Umlilo uhlala uvutha.
drafts-xh-01-053.en: One cloud over the mountain is not a weather event. The fire stays lit.

drafts-xh-01-054.text: Ilifu phezu kwentaba, ipotjie phantsi kwelapa. Zombini zisafuna enye iyure.
drafts-xh-01-054.en: Cloud over the mountain, potjie under the lapa. Both need another hour.

drafts-xh-01-055.text: Amafu ahlale kade ngenxa yombala kuphela. UMvulo ebetyala wonke umntu oko.
drafts-xh-01-055.en: The clouds stayed late just for the colour. Monday owed everyone that much.

drafts-xh-01-056.text: Amafu emva kwemini yonke, akukho thontsi. Umbhobho wamanzi ubuyele emsebenzini.
drafts-xh-01-056.en: Clouds all afternoon, not a drop. The hose is back on duty.

drafts-xh-01-057.text: Isibhakabhaka senza umboniso. Iintlanzi, njengesiqhelo, azenzi.
drafts-xh-01-057.en: The sky's putting on a show. The fish, as usual, are not.

drafts-xh-01-058.text: Amafu okutshona kwelanga, izitshizi zeediliya. Ifama izilungiselela eyayo imvula.
drafts-xh-01-058.en: Clouds for the sunset, sprinklers for the vines. The farm arranges its own rain.

drafts-xh-01-059.text: Ilanga liphume emsebenzini. Amafu asakhanya, kunye nebhalkoni.
drafts-xh-01-059.en: The sun's clocked out. The clouds are still lit, and so is the balcony.

drafts-xh-01-060.text: Amafu abe pinki kanye ngexesha lokupakisha. Akukho mntu upakishileyo.
drafts-xh-01-060.en: The clouds turned pink right on packing-up time. Nobody packed up.

drafts-xh-01-061.text: Iinkomo zisekhaya phambi kokuba umbala uphele. ICawa iphela ngexesha kanye.
drafts-xh-01-061.en: The cattle are home before the colour goes. Sunday ends exactly on schedule.

drafts-xh-01-062.text: Inyanga ikhanya kancinci ngokuhlwanje. Isibane sokhuseleko asinako oko.
drafts-xh-01-062.en: The moon's on a dimmer tonight. The security light has no such setting.

drafts-xh-01-063.text: Isiqingatha senyanga, isiqingatha selifu, umgqomo ugcwele. NgoLwesibini ebusuku, njengoko kwakuthenjisiwe.
drafts-xh-01-063.en: Half moon, half cloud, full bin. Tuesday night, as advertised.

drafts-xh-01-064.text: Inyanga isoloko iphuma ijonga igaraji. Akukho nto yenzekayo.
drafts-xh-01-064.en: The moon keeps popping out to check on the forecourt. Still nothing happening.

drafts-xh-01-065.text: Amafu ayayidlulisana inyanga. Ibhalkoni ivuya ukulinda.
drafts-xh-01-065.en: The clouds are passing the moon around. The balcony is happy to wait.

drafts-xh-01-066.text: Inyanga ityelela phakathi kwamafu. Iyayiva ivumba lenyama ukusuka phaya phezulu.
drafts-xh-01-066.en: The moon drops in between clouds. It can smell the meat from up there.

drafts-xh-01-067.text: Isiqingatha seenkwenkwezi singemva kwamafu. Izibane ezincinci zibathathela indawo.
drafts-xh-01-067.en: Half the stars are behind cloud. The fairy lights are covering for them.

drafts-xh-01-068.text: Inyanga ingemva kwelifu, inja isestoep. Inkonzo yangeCawa iphelile.
drafts-xh-01-068.en: Moon behind a cloud, dog on the stoep. Sunday's service is over.

drafts-xh-01-069.text: Ngu-6 kusasa, kwaye ifriji sele iyeyona ndawo ithandwayo endlwini.
drafts-xh-01-069.en: It's 6am and the fridge is already the most popular room in the house.

drafts-xh-01-070.text: Inja iyawuthanda lo moya. Inenwele ekuphela kwazo ezenzelwe wona.
drafts-xh-01-070.en: The dog is loving this wind. He's got the only hairstyle built for it.

drafts-xh-01-071.text: Kuyabanda nyhani namhlanje. Yingqele egqobhoza iijezi ezintathu ngathi azikho.
drafts-xh-01-071.en: Properly cold today. The kind that goes through three jerseys like they aren't there.

drafts-xh-01-072.text: Nditsho nabo bafunga ukuba akuze kubande ngoku bayavuma.
drafts-xh-01-072.en: Even the people who swear it never gets cold are admitting it.

drafts-xh-01-073.text: Umphefumlo omnye womoya wemvula, ngequbuliso ilizwe lonke liyimbongi.
drafts-xh-01-073.en: One breath of rain air and suddenly the whole country is a poet.

drafts-xh-01-074.text: Imvula efama ayiyiyo imozulu nje. Ngumvuzo owela esibhakabhakeni.
drafts-xh-01-074.en: Rain on a farm isn't weather. It's a salary falling from the sky.

drafts-xh-01-075.text: ITar emanzi ekuphumeni kwelanga. Asilovumba elo, lilifa.
drafts-xh-01-075.en: Wet tar at sunrise. That's not a smell, that's heritage.

drafts-xh-01-076.text: Imvula yaseJoburg inedayari: ngo-2 emva kwemini kanye, idrama eninzi, akukho kuxolisa.
drafts-xh-01-076.en: Joburg rain keeps a diary: 2pm sharp, maximum drama, no apologies.

drafts-xh-01-077.text: Onke amacebo ngoku afuduselwe 'xa kuthe kwacaca'. Okungasoze kwenzeke. Hayi bo.
drafts-xh-01-077.en: All plans are officially moved to 'when it clears up'. Which is never. Shame.

drafts-xh-01-078.text: Imvula yaseHighveld uyayiva ngevumba phambi kokuba uyibone. Yintshayelelo leyo.
drafts-xh-01-078.en: You smell Highveld rain before you see it. That's the trailer.

drafts-xh-01-079.text: Kumanqanaba amadama! Yonke imvula enkulu sisipho sasimahla.
drafts-xh-01-079.en: To the dam levels! Every downpour is a round on the house.

drafts-xh-01-080.en: Breaking news: the puddles are open for business.

drafts-xh-01-081.text: Isekude ngeekhilomitha ezingamashumi amahlanu, kodwa istoep sele sigcwele.
drafts-xh-01-081.en: It's still fifty kilometres away and the stoep is already sold out.

drafts-xh-01-082.text: Ungwevu kusasa. Mayihlale nje kancinci, njengeti.
drafts-xh-01-082.en: Early grey. Like the tea, just let it steep.

drafts-xh-01-083.text: Ungwevu nawo ngumbala, utsho umama. Namhlanje ndiyamkholelwa.
drafts-xh-01-083.en: Grey is also a colour, says my ma. Today I believe her.

drafts-xh-01-084.text: Isibhakabhaka sinxibe isuti yodliwano-ndlebe: ngwevu, icocekile, ayixeli nto.
drafts-xh-01-084.en: The sky is in its interview suit: grey, neat, giving nothing away.

drafts-xh-01-085.text: Ungwevu wempelaveki: imvume esemthethweni yokungenzi nto konke konke.
drafts-xh-01-085.en: Weekend grey: official permission to do absolutely nothing.

drafts-xh-01-086.text: Usuku olungwevu lusuku lokubhaka. Ikhitshi lomntu othile sele linuka kamnandi.
drafts-xh-01-086.en: Grey day equals baking day. Somebody's kitchen already smells amazing.

drafts-xh-01-087.text: Ilanga liphume emsebenzini lingavalelisanga. Akukho mbeko, kodwa siyaqonda.
drafts-xh-01-087.en: The sun clocked out without saying bye. Rude, but relatable.

drafts-xh-01-088.text: Ukutshona kwelanga kuthe cwaka ngokuhlwanje. Ubusuku bufikile noko.
drafts-xh-01-088.en: Dusk is on mute tonight. The evening showed up anyway.

drafts-xh-01-089.text: Isibhakabhaka sizigqumile. Iingubo zakho ziyakulinda. Kuyenzeka nje? Hayi.
drafts-xh-01-089.en: The sky is under the covers. Yours are waiting. Coincidence? Never.

drafts-xh-01-090.text: UGqirha uhamba ejonga kusasa. Akufuneki kubhukisha, ngelishwa.
drafts-xh-01-090.en: The Doctor's on morning rounds. No appointment needed, unfortunately.

drafts-xh-01-091.text: Ilaphu letafile lu-ayinile kwaye lilungele umsebenzi wangomso.
drafts-xh-01-091.en: The tablecloth is pressed and ready for tomorrow's service.

drafts-xh-01-092.text: Ingqele yaseKapa yingqele emanzi. Ingena emathanjeni akho ize ihlale.
drafts-xh-01-092.en: Cape cold is wet cold. It moves into your bones and unpacks.

drafts-xh-01-093.text: Ubusika baseHighveld: ukutshiswa lilanga nokubanjwa ngumkhenkce kunokwenzeka ngosuku olunye.
drafts-xh-01-093.en: Highveld winter: sunburn and frostbite achievable on the same day.

drafts-xh-01-094.text: Kufutshane ngokwaneleyo ukuba ukuncome, kude ngokwaneleyo ukuba ungawuqhwanyazeli. Kugqibelele.
drafts-xh-01-094.en: Close enough to admire, far enough that you don't have to shovel it. Perfect.

drafts-xh-01-095.text: Ingqele emanzi yaselwandle: lolo hlobo lugqobhoza iingubo ezine nomoya omhle.
drafts-xh-01-095.en: Wet sea cold: the kind that gets through four layers and a good mood.

drafts-xh-01-096.text: Uyayibona ingqele isiza. Ayizifihli konke konke.
drafts-xh-01-096.en: You can watch the cold arriving. It's not even being subtle about it.

drafts-xh-01-097.text: Sihleli phandle engqeleni kuba ngaphakathi, inyani, kubanda ngakumbi.
drafts-xh-01-097.en: We're visiting outside in the cold because inside is, honestly, colder.

drafts-xh-01-098.text: Amabhadi akanxibi zikhafu kwaye akakhalazi. Singafunda into. Asizukufunda, kodwa singafunda.
drafts-xh-01-098.en: The blesbok wear no scarves and file no complaints. We could learn something. We won't, but we could.

drafts-xh-01-099.text: Isiqwengana sokugqibela seenkuni sisigqibo, asiyonto nje ekhoyo.
drafts-xh-01-099.en: The last log is a decision, not an inventory item.

drafts-xh-01-100.text: Ndilibale ukuvula ingubo yombane kwangethuba. Qho. Ngobusuku. Bonke.
drafts-xh-01-100.en: Forgot to switch the electric blanket on in advance. Every. Single. Night.

drafts-xh-01-101.text: Ifronti ihambile. Ingqele yona ifudukele apha ngokusisigxina.
drafts-xh-01-101.en: The front left. The cold just moved in permanently.

drafts-xh-01-102.text: Isibhakabhaka sanamhlanje: sisandul' ukuhlanjwa, sayinwa ngumkhenkce.

drafts-xh-01-103.en: It's a beautiful day to stay indoors.

drafts-xh-01-104.text: Yimozulu efanelekileyo yokomisa impahla. Impahla iza kuoma ize ibe ngumkhenkce, ngolo landelelwano.
drafts-xh-01-104.en: Perfect drying weather. The washing will dry and freeze, in that order.

drafts-xh-01-105.text: Icala elinesithunzi lebala lilizwe lalo ngokwalo.
drafts-xh-01-105.en: The shady side of the field is a separate climate zone.

drafts-xh-01-106.en: Padstal coffee is functioning as central heating today.

drafts-xh-01-107.text: Lelona xesha lihle losuku. Kwaye lelona lifutshane. Baleka.
drafts-xh-01-107.en: Prettiest moment of the day. Also the shortest. Run.

drafts-xh-01-108.text: Jonga ngokukhawuleza. Kwimizuzu elishumi kuza kuba bubusuku nengqele enkulu.
drafts-xh-01-108.en: Look quickly. In ten minutes it's night and the North Pole.

drafts-xh-01-109.text: IKaroo ivula uphahla lwayo ebusuku. Nxiba iimpahla ezifudumeleyo kumboniso.
drafts-xh-01-109.en: The Karoo is opening its roof for the night. Dress warm for the show.

drafts-xh-01-110.text: IRooibos esandleni, ingubo ide ifike ezindlebeni. Sizixhobile.
drafts-xh-01-110.en: Rooibos in hand, blanket to the ears. Full kit.

drafts-xh-01-111.text: Akukho moya, akukho mafu, akukho sizathu sale bhatyi ibhityileyo.
drafts-xh-01-111.en: No wind, no clouds, no excuse for that thin jacket.

drafts-xh-01-112.text: Uphefumla ngathi yinamba enomlilo, umbono ngathi liphupha.
drafts-xh-01-112.en: Breathing like a dragon, view like a dream.

drafts-xh-01-113.text: Umoya oshushu wasezintabeni utshintshe ebusuku. Kapa, namhlanje uphantse ube yi-Upington.
drafts-xh-01-113.en: The berg wind turned overnight. Cape Town, today you're basically Upington.

drafts-xh-01-114.text: Ulwandle luziidigri ezili-12. Ngentsimbi yeshumi luza kuziva ngathi yispa.
drafts-xh-01-114.en: The sea is 12 degrees. By ten o'clock it's going to feel like a spa.

drafts-xh-01-115.text: Ababalekayo ngo-5:30 abomelele kunathi. Nje bakrelekrele ngakumbi.
drafts-xh-01-115.en: The 5:30 runners aren't fitter than us. They're just smarter.

drafts-xh-01-116.text: Nditsho nenja ijonge imozulu yaza yabuyela ebhedini.
drafts-xh-01-116.en: Even the dog checked the forecast and went straight back to bed.

drafts-xh-01-117.text: Yiza nomkhenkce wakho. Ubuhlobo abubandakanyi umkhenkce.
drafts-xh-01-117.en: Bring your own ice. The friendship doesn't cover ice.

drafts-xh-01-118.text: Ukuthamba kokuqala emva kosuku lweedigri ezingama-35 bekufanele ukuba kuhlawulelwe irhafu, inyani.
drafts-xh-01-118.en: The first sip after a 35-degree day should honestly be taxable.

drafts-xh-01-119.en: We don't talk about today. Today is over. We're proud of us.

drafts-xh-01-120.text: Umoya omncinci wokuqala wosuku usandul' ukufika. Wuqhwabele izandla.
drafts-xh-01-120.en: The first breeze of the day has just arrived. Give it a round of applause.

drafts-xh-01-121.text: Ifama isekhona. Sikholelwa nje kwilizwi lomnye nomnye.
drafts-xh-01-121.en: The farm is still there. We're all just taking each other's word for it.

drafts-xh-01-122.text: Iinkomo ziyazi kanye apho zikhoyo. Ngaphezu koko thina sinokukutsho.
drafts-xh-01-122.en: The cows know exactly where they are. Which is more than the rest of us can say.

drafts-xh-01-123.text: Ukubona: akukho. Isimo sengqondo: sizolile, ngokumangalisayo.
drafts-xh-01-123.en: Visibility: zero. Mood: surprisingly at peace with it.

drafts-xh-01-124.text: Yonke ifestile ekhanyayo ngumntu ogqibe kwelokuba: kwanele namhlanje.
drafts-xh-01-124.en: Every window switching on is someone deciding: that's enough for today.

drafts-xh-01-125.en: Fireplace weather showed up without even asking.

drafts-xh-01-126.text: Yimozulu efanelekileyo yokudibana nomntu 'obusoloko uceba ukumtsalela umnxeba'.
drafts-xh-01-126.en: Perfect weather to bump into someone you've 'been meaning to call'.

drafts-xh-01-127.en: The whole town just switched itself to whisper volume.

drafts-xh-01-128.en: Let's call it atmosphere and go inside.

drafts-xh-01-129.text: Ulwandle lunyamalele kodwa oomakazi bakhona. Izinto eziphambili.
drafts-xh-01-129.en: The sea has vanished but the tannies are here. Priorities.

drafts-xh-01-130.text: Owokugqibela ukudlula uvala isango. Nokuba akukho mntu ulibonayo.
drafts-xh-01-130.en: Last one through closes the gate. Even if nobody can see it.

drafts-xh-01-131.text: Inkungu yentsimbi yeshumi ebusuku yenza zonke izitrato zibe ziindawo zokwenza ifilimu.
drafts-xh-01-131.en: Ten pm fog turns every street into a film set.

drafts-xh-01-132.text: Abamelwane abakufutshane bakude ngeekhilomitha ezingamashumi amathathu, kwaye ngokuhlwanje bakubona kancinci ngakumbi.
drafts-xh-01-132.en: The nearest neighbours are thirty kilometres away and tonight they can see you even less.

drafts-xh-01-133.text: Ilanga liqale umsebenzi phambi kokuba i-alamu yakho izame.
drafts-xh-01-133.en: The sun clocked in before your alarm even tried.

drafts-xh-01-134.text: Akukho mpazamo namhlanje ukuza kuthi ga ngoku. Nesibhakabhaka.
drafts-xh-01-134.en: Zero mistakes from today so far. Sky included.

drafts-xh-01-135.text: Iintsasa zaseHighveld: kubanda kakhulu, kuhle, akukho kuxolisa.
drafts-xh-01-135.en: Highveld mornings: freezing, gorgeous, zero apologies.

drafts-xh-01-136.text: Imozulu eziphethe kakuhle kangaka ngokuqinisekileyo iceba into.
drafts-xh-01-136.en: Weather this well-behaved is definitely up to something.

drafts-xh-01-137.en: Out here even the sun refuses to rush.

drafts-xh-01-138.text: Imozulu entle kangaka yeyokubolekwa. Umoya wasempuma-mzantsi ugcina iirisithi.
drafts-xh-01-138.en: Weather this perfect is on loan. The southeaster keeps receipts.

drafts-xh-01-139.text: Imozulu yenze amacebo. Thina siphendule nje sathi siyeza.
drafts-xh-01-139.en: The weather made the plans. We just RSVP'd.

drafts-xh-01-140.text: Isibhakabhaka saseKaroo: luhlaza okwesibhakabhaka olufanayo kwiikhilomitha ezingama-400 ezizayo. Kuqinisekisiwe.
drafts-xh-01-140.en: Karoo sky: same flawless blue for the next 400 km. Guaranteed.

drafts-xh-01-141.text: Ilanga lithatha ixesha elide lisiya kutshona. Inyani, liyakufanele.
drafts-xh-01-141.en: The sun is really milking this exit. Honestly, deserved.

drafts-xh-01-142.text: Xa imozulu iziphethe kakuhle kangaka, nathi siyaziphatha. Phantse.
drafts-xh-01-142.en: When the weather behaves this well, so do we. Roughly.

drafts-xh-01-143.text: Yithi inyani — uvule le app ukuze uqinisekise ibraai yangoMgqibelo.
drafts-xh-01-143.en: Be honest — you opened this app to confirm Saturday's braai.

drafts-xh-01-144.text: Usuku oluhle kangangokuba nditsho nexesha lezithuthi ezininzi beliziva ngathi ngumba wokuzikhethela.
drafts-xh-01-144.en: A day so good even rush hour felt optional.

drafts-xh-01-145.text: Inkungu yaseMidlands: indlela amaphandle azifihla ngayo.
drafts-xh-01-145.en: Midlands mist: the countryside's privacy setting.

drafts-xh-01-146.text: Hamba ngoku okanye ungahambi konke. ILowveld ikunika ixesha de kube yintsimbi yesixhenxe.
drafts-xh-01-146.en: Walk now or don't walk at all. The Lowveld gives you until seven.

drafts-xh-01-147.text: Nditsho neempala zimi emthunzini ziphinda zicinga ngezigqibo zazo.
drafts-xh-01-147.en: Even the impala are standing in the shade rethinking their choices.

drafts-xh-01-148.en: Lowveld summer: you don't sweat, you melt with dignity.

drafts-xh-01-149.text: Ihlathi lithe cwaka namhlanje. Wonke umntu. Yonke into.
drafts-xh-01-149.en: The bushveld is on silent mode today. Everyone. Everything.

drafts-xh-01-150.text: Isiselo sokutshona kwelanga asiyonto yobunewunewu eLowveld. Lichiza.
drafts-xh-01-150.en: Sundowners aren't a luxury in the Lowveld. They're medical.

drafts-xh-01-152.text: IDolophu enoBubele ayizange icele ukuba yiDolophu enoMoya, kodwa ke.
drafts-xh-01-152.en: The Friendly City never asked to be the Windy City, and yet.

drafts-xh-01-153.text: IJeffreys Bay: apho umoya uzilolonga khona phambi komsebenzi wawo eKapa.
drafts-xh-01-153.en: Jeffreys Bay: where the wind warms up before its Cape Town shift.

drafts-xh-01-154.en: Gqeberha doesn't sleep, it just holds on.
